title: Admit Case 002 into the multi-case How We Know library
objective: Select the exact independently reviewed EM-0029 dossier through an accepted manifest, generalize the single-case application adapter into a deterministic multi-case How We Know library, and expose Case 002 through coherent human and agent interfaces without altering Case 001 evidence or overstating the bounded pilot.
required_evaluation: exact candidate-dossier and independent-review-receipt byte, digest, length, format, reviewer, reviewed-head, and independence binding
multi-dossier manifest enumeration with duplicate number, slug, dossier identity, and route rejection
Case 001 dossier, receipt, manifest, routes, policy views, counts, and generated bytes regression review
Case 002 relation-derived scoreboard, sentence-to-source closure, unresolved/no-credit visibility, and agent-lineage dependence tests
material encyclopedia-versus-skeptical output-difference tests over identical Case 002 evidence objects
How We Know index, homepage discovery cue, review receipt, Markdown, JSON, llms.txt, sitemap, OpenAPI, local REST, MCP, and CLI parity tests
cold-start agent discovery and bounded Case 002 summary test using only committed public outputs
no-JavaScript fallback, keyboard-accessibility, desktop and mobile visual review, link integrity, and content-type checks
whole-release catalog, frontier, compiler, accepted-commit, content-digest, and manifest identity-parity test
public disclosure noninterference audit, full deterministic make check, exact path-scope comparison, and clean tracked state
fresh-clone independent exact-head review before protected merge
provider and route read-back after a separately authorized accepted Pages deployment
acceptance: an explicit accepted manifest selects exactly the independently reviewed Case 002 dossier and receipt without modifying their bytes
the compiler discovers every accepted dossier manifest deterministically and fails closed on duplicate identities, numbers, slugs, unsupported formats, receipt drift, or route collisions
Case 001 remains byte-bound, fully reachable, and semantically unchanged while the How We Know index lists Cases 001 and 002 as distinct evidence files
Case 002 has stable encyclopedia, skeptical, review, Markdown, JSON, share-card, API-style, MCP, and CLI representations derived from one disclosure-safe dossier

the public Case 002 card distinguishes reports, URL strings, source works, candidate warrant roots, and unresolved citation occurrences and never labels report/profile multiplicity as independent evidence
every displayed Case 002 count opens a complete ledger and every material sentence exposes the exact accepted work, edition, span, digest, and license treatment required for inspection
the skeptical view changes the first-screen finding and practical reading rather than merely changing a path or style
the homepage retains Case 001 as the established lead while giving Case 002 a compact, truthful library-level discovery path; no unreviewed future case is advertised as available
a cold-start agent can discover both cases from llms.txt and recover Case 002's question, bounded verdict, count grammar, dependence warning, unresolved set, and review limitations
all emitted interfaces carry one coherent catalog, frontier, accepted commit, compiler, policies, dossier identity, and content digest for the release
make check passes without changing accepted source state
after separately authorized deployment, epistemedia.org read-back confirms every Case 002 route, content type, canonical URL, release identity, keyboard path, and mobile layout
limitations: This task admits a bounded historical pilot, not a current vendor ranking, universal agent-quality estimate, benchmark leaderboard, or claim that the seven candidate warrants are independent research programs.
The existing application dossier and manifest formats remain reversible alpha adapters and are not promoted into normative schemas or protocol semantics.
Case 001 research meaning and accepted bytes must not change as a side effect of adding the library.
A merged configuration or successful local build is not proof of live deployment; production status requires a separate authorized Pages run and provider plus route read-back.
Hosted API/MCP activation, new lenses, Case 003 research, workflow privilege changes, DNS changes, package publication, provider calls, credentials, accounts, and spend remain out of scope.
